ciso.title: CISO / Executive Security Leadership
ciso.description: Lead an organization's overall cybersecurity program, risk governance, budget strategy, C-suite alignment, and Board reporting.
day_to_day: Board of Directors reporting & risk presentations
growth_paths: Board Director / Security Advisory Board Member
ciso.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Build strong business acumen. CISOs are business executives first and security technologists second. Master risk quantification (FAIR), financial budgeting, and speaking the language of business risk.

soc_analyst.title: SOC Analyst (Security Operations Center)
soc_analyst.description: Monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents in real time. The first line of defense.
soc_analyst.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Get Security+ first. Then set up a home lab with a free Splunk license and practice analyzing logs from TryHackMe or a vulnerable VM.

penetration_tester.title: Penetration Tester / Ethical Hacker
penetration_tester.description: Get paid to legally hack systems, networks, and applications to find vulnerabilities before attackers do.
day_to_day: Conduct network and web app pen tests
penetration_tester.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Labs beat certs in this field. Do 50+ machines on TryHackMe/HackTheBox before worrying about OSCP. Build a public GitHub of your writeups.

grc.title: GRC Analyst (Governance, Risk & Compliance)
grc.description: Manage security programs, assess risk, ensure regulatory compliance, and build policies that protect the organization.
grc.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Strong writing and communication skills matter more here than technical skills. Study one framework deeply (start with NIST CSF) and get CISA if you have accounting/audit background.

cloud_security.title: Cloud Security Engineer
cloud_security.description: Design, implement, and monitor security controls for cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
cloud_security.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Pick one cloud provider and go deep. Get your associate-level cloud cert, then the security specialty. Cloud skills pay a significant premium over traditional security roles.

ot_ics_scada.title: OT / ICS / SCADA Critical Infrastructure Security Specialist
ot_ics_scada.description: Protect industrial control systems, manufacturing plants, smart grids, oil & gas pipelines, and SCADA networks.
ot_ics_scada.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Pivoting from electrical engineering, automation, or SCADA engineering into security commands high salaries. Focus on GICSP and ISA 62443 standards.

dfir.title: Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Specialist
dfir.description: Investigate complex enterprise breaches, analyze malware, reconstruct intruder timelines, and preserve digital evidence.
dfir.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Practice memory and disk image analysis on CyberDefenders or SANS DFIR challenges using Eric Zimmerman tools.

ai_governance_security.title: AI Security & AI Governance Specialist
ai_governance_security.description: Secure enterprise AI deployments, prevent prompt injection/data poisoning, and ensure compliance with AI governance frameworks.
day_to_day: LLM red teaming & prompt injection audits
AI model supply chain risk assessments
EU AI Act & AI policy drafting
ai_governance_security.breaking_into_cyber_tips: Study the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and the NIST AI RMF. Position yourself as the bridge between data science teams and cybersecurity governance.
